heading.en: Taste one spoon or the whole pot?

hook.en: To check if the sambar has enough salt, a cook tastes one spoon, not the whole pot. Can we study people the same way?
hook.kn: ಸಾಂಬಾರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಉಪ್ಪು ಸರಿಯಿದೆಯೇ ಎಂದು ಅಡುಗೆಯವರು ಒಂದು ಚಮಚ ರುಚಿ ನೋಡುತ್ತಾರೆ, ಇಡೀ ಪಾತ್ರೆಯಲ್ಲ. ಜನರನ್ನೂ ಹೀಗೆ ಅಧ್ಯಯನ ಮಾಡಬಹುದೇ?

narration.en: To check if the sambar has enough salt, a cook tastes one spoon, not the whole pot. Can we study people the same way?
narration.kn: ಸಾಂಬಾರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಉಪ್ಪು ಸರಿಯಿದೆಯೇ ಎಂದು ಅಡುಗೆಯವರು ಒಂದು ಚಮಚ ರುಚಿ ನೋಡುತ್ತಾರೆ, ಇಡೀ ಪಾತ್ರೆಯಲ್ಲ. ಜನರನ್ನೂ ಹೀಗೆ ಅಧ್ಯಯನ ಮಾಡಬಹುದೇ?

body.en: The population (universe) is the whole group under study. In a census every unit is studied. A sample is a small group drawn from the population to represent it. A good sample is representative and gives reasonably accurate results at much lower cost and time.
body.kn: ಅಧ್ಯಯನದ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಗುಂಪು ಸಮಷ್ಟಿ. ಗಣತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದು ಘಟಕವನ್ನೂ ಅಧ್ಯಯನ ಮಾಡುತ್ತೇವೆ. ಮಾದರಿ ಸಮಷ್ಟಿಯನ್ನು ಪ್ರತಿನಿಧಿಸುವ ಸಣ್ಣ ಗುಂಪು.

title.en: On the board: Population and sample

say.en: The population is the whole group we study. Here, 60 students in a class.
A census studies every one of them. A sample studies a few chosen to represent all.
Census: complete but costly. Sample: cheaper, quicker and good enough when chosen well.
Random sampling: every unit has an equal chance, like drawing slips by lottery.

prompt.en: For each study, decide whether every unit should be studied (census) or a representative part (sample).
prompt.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ಅಧ್ಯಯನಕ್ಕೆ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಘಟಕಗಳನ್ನು ಅಧ್ಯಯನ ಮಾಡಬೇಕೇ (ಗಣತಿ) ಅಥವಾ ಪ್ರತಿನಿಧಿ ಭಾಗವನ್ನೇ (ಮಾದರಿ) ಎಂದು ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸಿ.

text.en: Counting every person in India once in ten years
Preparing the voters' list of a village
Recording the marks of all 40 students of a class
Counting every cattle head for the Livestock Census
Checking the quality of matchboxes (testing burns them)
Estimating the average yield of rice in Karnataka
Finding out quickly which TV channels a city watches

explanation.en: A census suits a small population, or when information on every unit is needed. A sample saves time and money, and is the only choice when testing destroys the unit or the population is very large.

body.en: In random sampling each unit has an equal chance of selection, for example by lottery or random number tables, so the investigator's bias is removed. In non-random sampling, units are chosen by convenience, judgement or quota, so not every unit has a chance.
body.kn: ಯಾದೃಚ್ಛಿಕ ಮಾದರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದು ಘಟಕಕ್ಕೂ ಆಯ್ಕೆಯ ಸಮಾನ ಅವಕಾಶ. ಯಾದೃಚ್ಛಿಕವಲ್ಲದ ಮಾದರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅನುಕೂಲ ಅಥವಾ ತೀರ್ಮಾನದಿಂದ ಆಯ್ಕೆ.

caption.en: A survey costs ₹c for each unit studied. Compare the cost of a census of N units with a sample of n units.

narration.en: See why most surveys use a sample instead of a census.

tryThis.en: With N = 20,000 and n = 800, what fraction is surveyed?
Double the sample. What happens to the cost and the fraction?
When would a census still be needed?

problem.en: A class has 60 students. The teacher writes roll numbers 1–60 on slips, mixes them and draws 10 to measure heights. Identify the population, sample, sample size and method.

steps.en: Sample: the 10 students drawn; sample size = 10.
Each slip had an equal chance: random sampling by the lottery method.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. A class has 60 students. The teacher writes roll numbers 1–60 on slips, mixes them and draws 10 to measure heights. Identify the population, sample, sample size and method.
Class quiz. Discuss, raise hands, and the monitor taps the class answer.

points.kn: ಗಣತಿ ಎಲ್ಲ ಘಟಕಗಳನ್ನು, ಮಾದರಿ ಒಂದು ಭಾಗವನ್ನು ಅಧ್ಯಯನ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: A good sample represents the population.
Random sampling gives every unit an equal chance.

homework.en: Pick a random sample of 5 students from your class list using the lottery method.

narration.en: Recap. A census studies every unit; a sample studies a part. A good sample represents the population. Random sampling gives every unit an equal chance.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಗಣತಿ ಎಲ್ಲ ಘಟಕಗಳನ್ನು, ಮಾದರಿ ಒಂದು ಭಾಗವನ್ನು ಅಧ್ಯಯನ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಉತ್ತಮ ಮಾದರಿ ಸಮಷ್ಟಿಯನ್ನು ಪ್ರತಿನಿಧಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಯಾದೃಚ್ಛಿಕ ಮಾದರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಸಮಾನ ಅವಕಾಶ.
